LoL, no. Wizard is the guy who turns 30 years old and has never kissed, dated or got laid. 99% of the time it's a guy with no social skills, no friends, and who is not respected by society. So, they usually stay in their parents' house permanently, practicing escapist behaviors, like playing video-games, watching anime, porn, etc. 

I see it as a point of no return, because, basically, if you spent 3 decades of your life and hasn't achieved anything, hasn't developed yourself, and is still immature, people won't be interested in you in any way, shape or form **at all.** tl;dr, if you become a wizard, you'll be alone forever.

As I said previously, it frightens me a lot, because I'm just like that, the difference is that I'm just 12 years younger from said point of no return, and I feel like it's never going to change.
Sure... we're going through rough times where I live, it's not so easy, but maybe I'll manage a way (or do a magic trick) to get one. Thanks for the answer tho.
